title: Captura VUE após tela em repouso e medida do botão marcado

scope.purpose: resume the current GTK2 comparison after the Apollo display went black

input.event: one guest Shift frame; automatically released on frame 2

native_capture.visible: HP VUE File Finder and its buttons are visible after the wake pulse
native_capture.interpretation_limit: The capture does not identify whether this button mark is keyboard focus, default state, or both. R214 isolates GTK2 states but does not infer the VUE state machine.

limits: The bridge's capture flags do not measure an SDL host pointer grab on window activation.
No VM configuration, guest file, host focus, or mouse input was changed.
This is a native VM image and pixel measurement, not human approval of the GTK2 theme.
next: Continue I167/GTK2 with a controlled comparison of the native button's depressed visual state, after confirming that the intended button can be activated and restored without losing the current Find Files fields.
